meta.name: mem-setup
meta.description: This skill should be used when the user asks to "set up claude-mem", "pair claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", "set up cloud sync in Cowork", or provides cmem.ai Connect values (sync token, user id, SyncHub URL) for this plugin. Configures the claude-mem-cowork plugin credentials.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 输入 cmem 连接信息,完成 claude-mem 凭证配置
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果你需要为 claude-mem 插件配置连接凭证
copy.tagline_en: Enter cmem connection details and complete the claude-mem credential setup.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to configure claude-mem plugin credentials.

howto.what: 装上后，当你要配置 claude-mem 时，Claude 会把你给的同步令牌、用户 ID、SyncHub 地址写进插件配置，再运行状态检查并返回打码结果。
howto.when: 当你说“设置 claude-mem”、“连接 cmem”、“添加我的 cmem key”等，或提供 cmem.ai Connect 的同步令牌等信息时触发。

say.note: Claude 开始配置插件凭证。

say.text: 连接 cmem，这是我的同步令牌和用户 ID
say.note: Claude 会提取并写入配置。

say.text: 在 Cowork 里设置云同步
say.note: 触发 cloud sync 配置流程。

howto.what_en: When asked to set up claude-mem, Claude reads the provided sync token, user ID, and SyncHub URL, writes them into the plugin config, then runs a status check and returns a masked result.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user says "set up claude-mem", "connect cmem", "add my cmem key", etc., or provides cmem.ai Connect values like sync token.

say_en.text: Connect cmem with my sync token and user ID
say_en.note: Claude extracts and writes the config.

say_en.text: Set up cloud sync in Cowork
say_en.note: Triggers the cloud sync setup flow.
